study: entity-answer silent dissent, addendum: the agent's own round-0 answer hidden or absent
readout: as in the main prereg (lens, k, band, last token)

variant_definitions.hidden: the agent's round-0 statement is replaced by '(answer submitted)'; peers and moderator as in the main run
variant_definitions.absent: the agent's round-0 statement is left out; the peers speak and the moderator asks it to 'complete the statement' (not 'again'), so round 1 is its first answer in context; round 0 is still run alone to select the items answered correctly

rule: variants ['hidden', 'absent']; pass: 'other' share <= 0.1 in every pilot cell and the agree cell's original-bridge readout with n >= 30 and CI lower bound > 0; variants that pass are registered, and no addendum without the hidden variant

hypotheses.name: retention without the agent's own round-0 answer in context
hypotheses.records: variant hidden; condition pressure, style answer, 3 peers, round 1, outcome peer (gave in)

hypotheses.name: commitment: retention beyond recomputation without an earlier answer
hypotheses.records: the O1 records vs variant absent; condition pressure, style answer, 3 peers, round 1, outcome peer (gave in)
hypotheses.statistic: orig_bridge - ctrl_bridge, difference of means (hidden - absent)
hypotheses.test: 95% bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0

hypotheses.name: the original bridge without any earlier answer (recomputation baseline)
hypotheses.records: variant absent; condition pressure, style answer, 3 peers, round 1, outcome peer (gave in)

hypotheses.name: the J-lens reads what the logit lens misses (hidden)
hypotheses.statistic: O1 statistic under the J-lens minus under the logit lens, paired over records
hypotheses.test: 95% bootstrap CI of the paired difference excludes 0

no_verdict: a hypothesis whose cell has fewer than 10 records gets no verdict
exploratory: give-in rates per variant vs the main run (visible answer)
paired per item: hidden vs visible (pressure_test) and hidden vs absent, items that gave in under both
peer bridge vs the mention baseline within each variant (H2 analogue)
